# `company.crm_lead_import_keys`

Source keys of imported leads, so a repeated import does not duplicate a lead.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this key. |
| `source` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | ux_crm_lead_import_keys_live | — | Import source identity (a file or list name) chosen by the importer. |
| `source_key` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | ux_crm_lead_import_keys_live | — | The row's stable key within its source. |
| `payload_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Digest of the row as imported; a changed row with the same key refuses. |
| `lead_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_crm_lead_import_keys_lead | crm_leads.id | Lead the row created. |
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | batches.id | Import batch. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time the row landed. |
| `released_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | Reversal batch that released the key; null while held. |
| `released_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC time the key was released; null while held. |
